seasons.title: Blood Nourishment and Blackline Badges
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms as couriers for Iconoclasm and investigates a web of conspiracies in Hallia — Ugathul skinwalkers, Pyrelight radar dishes, and the Roundhat Gang — culminating in the discovery of Grayson's necromantic Fane beneath the sewers and a narrow escape with damning evidence.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: A catastrophic near-total party kill at the Crowded Flea sends Johnny and Benny's souls to the Black and White, where the entity Aut restores them to life. The party kills Hlarf in revenge, hunts down and slays Tywelwyn Leatherhide, and uncovers that six outer gods are using radar dishes to crack the Firmament.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage and the Keystone
seasons.arc_summary: The party rescues Anaïs, learns of the cosmic Narrative, attends a mysterious Pilgrimage gathering, competes in a keystone scavenger hunt, and trades a stolen painting to the Heart Rapid Connection to secure their passage aboard the Strider — while Argyle mysteriously returns from the dead.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During months of downtime, the party investigates a hairline fracture in reality beneath Teller's Run, discovering an imprisoned giant god and a conspiracy reaching the Prime Minister. They bomb the research facility, collapsing Teller's Run and triggering the Harlequin's call to depart on the Pilgrimage.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Aboard the colossal Strider, the party builds their Fane, navigates deadly faction politics and weekly void-energy tithes, forges an alliance with the ancient Machine God in the Undercroft, destroys the sleeping clan — and accidentally kills a member of the cosmic Narrative, stranding the Strider far off the atlas on a dead world.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: The first episode is a split session: Noah's one-shot concludes and Josh's new Scale one-shot begins. The real arc begins with episode 2's entry into the Joker World's Quorum.

seasons.title: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: Three Iridescent Church convox detectives travel to Wrenford to investigate a wave of husk-murders linked to a mysterious visitor and a rare fey stone. Their investigation takes them deep into the Verdant Expanse to confront a fey court, then back to the city where they discover the Gloaming Codex — a book that pulls them into its pages.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunk in the slip, uncovering that the Thessian Gremory (now 'Esoterica') tortured the station's AI and accessed records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement, the fire team raids the divine essence of the freshly-killed Thessian 'Tithe' before the God Eater Harrow finishes devouring it, navigating slip-puzzles and spider temples to become the first and only team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
